last.verdict: MetLife posted its best quarterly profit per share ever, but a big jump in volatile investment returns drove much of it.

takeaways.label: Record, but investment-boosted
takeaways.text: Adjusted earnings per share rose 22% to $2.85 excluding one-offs. Returns on private equity and venture funds hit $720 million, against a roughly $400 million quarterly assumption. Management said they 'amplified' the quarter but did not 'define' it.

takeaways.label: Outlook reiterated
takeaways.text: Management kept its 2026 targets, including earnings growth 'well above' double digits and a 15%–17% return on equity. Q4 investment returns are assumed to fall back to about $400 million.

takeaways.label: Costs and one weak spot
takeaways.text: The share of revenue spent on direct expenses rose to 11.9% from 11.6%. Latin America earnings fell 5% on a currency-neutral basis, hurt by a negative Chilean pension investment return.

takeaways.label: Pension deals lighter
takeaways.text: Large pension-transfer volume has been light this year. Management called it timing, citing a back-ended pipeline. Group Benefits earnings rose 14% on favorable claims, though management expects that to ease gradually.

history.verdict: Investors cheered a clear profit beat driven by better insurance claims results.

reasons.label: Earnings beat
reasons.text: Adjusted earnings of $2.43 per share topped analyst estimates of about $2.29.

reasons.label: Better claims results
reasons.text: Group Benefits profit jumped 25% to $503 million on favorable underwriting and volume growth.

reasons.label: Broad growth, high returns
reasons.text: Every segment grew; return on equity hit 17% for a second straight quarter.
